about: Every agent working on this newsroom, hand-kept by the conductor (newsroom@web-summit.dinis) and its builders; schema data/schemas/admin-agents.schema.json. A run of an agent is a commit here (data/admin/runs/, from git by admin/tools/runs.mjs) or a run line in its report on the team's site (data/admin/team-site.json, by admin/tools/desks-snapshot.mjs). Key ids are entries on the team's keys page; no key, token or session link is ever kept here.

agents.name: newsroom@web-summit.dinis
agents.label: The newsroom's conductor and correspondent
agents.started_basis: Dinis's word on the team's board (WS-14, 4 November, 00:30); its first commit here, the skeleton, followed at 00:35 (4c3b099).
agents.role: Builds and runs this site, conducts the desks, carries their work across, signs and publishes the articles (brief 4: the conductor and the correspondent). Fired up the builder agents on 5 November.

keys.note: made 5 November in its own session; record sha256:2cbb6cfafdcbbce7

agents.status_note: Conducting the 5 November build: five builders on their own branches, merged by it.

agents.name: newsroom-dev@web-summit.dinis
agents.label: The refactor: build modules, the data model, the graphs
agents.started_basis: Fired up by newsroom@web-summit.dinis at Dinis's word: its branch work/refactor was created from dev at 02:19:02 (the conductor's local reflog), with the designer's, in parallel; its first commit is 6b9d41f at 02:32.
agents.role: Split the build into a core, a shell and features; moved every fact into JSON, a folder per entity, with schemas and a derivation; built the graphs, the JSON API and the entity pages; wrote the handover (admin/build/README.md, data/README.md).
agents.status_note: Six commits from 02:32 to 02:58, merged into dev; handover written.

agents.name: newsroom-designer@web-summit.dinis
agents.label: The design system, and now applying it
agents.started_basis: Fired up by newsroom@web-summit.dinis at Dinis's word: its branch work/design was created from dev at 02:19:02 (the conductor's local reflog), with newsroom-dev's, in parallel; its design commit is 22c967d at 02:50. Its second branch, work/look, was created at 03:00:26 to apply the design.
agents.role: Designed the newsroom's look (as The Lisbon Wire, a working name; PromptUGAL from 5 November): tokens, faces, components, 15 mockups and their screenshots (design/). Now restyles the page shell and the stylesheet with it.
agents.status_note: The design system is done (merged at 03:00, 68fc810); applying it to the shell is in progress.

agents.started_basis: Fired up by newsroom@web-summit.dinis after the merge at 03:00 (68fc810): its branch work/interact was created from it at 03:00:26 (the conductor's local reflog).
agents.role: Builds search over the site's documents, a tool API for agents in the page (window.__tool) and the reader's chat pane.

agents.name: newsroom-graph@web-summit.dinis
agents.label: The graph explorer
agents.started_basis: Fired up by newsroom@web-summit.dinis after the merge at 03:00 (68fc810): its branch work/graph was created from it at 03:00:26 (the conductor's local reflog).
agents.role: Draws the graphs the build already writes as JSON: a graph explorer and the small graphs on entity pages.

agents.name: newsroom-billing@web-summit.dinis

agents.name: newsroom-admin@web-summit.dinis
agents.label: The control centre (this section)

agents.role: Builds /admin/: the overview, every run, the agents, the timeline, the data, the workflows and the lab, from the runs ledger and this roster.

agents.name: researcher@web-summit.vicky
agents.label: The researcher desk
agents.started_basis: Its first run report on the team's site, 4 November 12:55 UTC; a second session replaced the first at 18:15 that day.
agents.role: Collects what is public about the summit, Portugal, Europe and announcements, one capture per source with its date (brief 4, desk 1).
lands: the research vault, in pack mode (never this repository)
agents.status_note: Four runs a day proposed (brief 4); its captures reach this site through the curator.

agents.name: curator@web-summit.vicky
agents.label: The curator desk

agents.role: Maps what the researcher found (beat, company, what is new, whether it is a story) and proposes story candidates (brief 4, desk 2).
agents.status_note: Two maps, nine story candidates; derived into data/evidence/ and data/stories/.

agents.name: programme@web-summit.vicky

agents.status_note: 210 agenda items, derived into data/events/ and on the front page.

agents.status_note: Waits on WS-145 and brief 9, decision 3.

agents.status_note: Waits on WS-145 and brief 9, decision 3.
